rangeAdd.description: flat range bonus (same units as type.range)

projectileCountAdd.description: extra projectiles per attack (summed across owned talents)

mods.description: Stat changes. Multipliers (attackInterval < 1 = faster) unless noted. `rangeAdd` is a flat bonus applied after any `range` multiplier.

fire.description: optional fire / oil on hit — applied when this tech is owned

produce.description: Battle production: while this pack lives, spawn `typeId` units on a timer (shared machinery for spider mothers, future dwarf forges, etc.).

onKill.description: On-kill spawn: each enemy this pack kills raises one `typeId` pack (no cap). Spawn type should not itself own this tech.

cleave.description: Point-blank disk attack: on each swing, every enemy in this XZ radius around the attacker takes this pack's damage (no projectile).

targets.description: Owning it replaces the pack's attack layers (Sky Bind: ground and air).

flight.description: Owning it changes flight: `lift` makes a ground unit a combat flyer, `ground` keeps it on the ground — `ground` wins over `lift` and natural flight. Structures and board extras are never affected.

grantsShieldHp.description: Owning it gives every mech of the pack a shield pool equal to its max HP (Aegis).

emp.description: On hit: hex the target — researched talents stop applying and move speed is multiplied by `speedMult` (default 0.6) for `duration` seconds. Golden / debuff-immune shrugs it off. Innate talents still apply.

vsAir.description: Extra damage / range vs airborne foes (`altitude > 0`). Multipliers.

vsGround.description: Extra damage / range vs grounded foes (`altitude <= 0`). Multipliers.

levelScale.description: Extra per-level scaling on top of the global veterancy mult. `damagePerLevel` / `rangePerLevel` are added per level above 1 (e.g. 0.1 → +10% per level).

regen.description: Passive HP regen while alive in battle.

lifesteal.description: Fraction of HP/shield damage dealt returned as pack HP (split among living members).

onKillHeal.description: On kill: heal this pack for `ofVictimMaxHp` × victim max HP (split among living members).

onDeath.description: On death: splash nova and/or acid puddle. Explode damage = dying body's maxHp × `damageMult` (default 1).

formationSpreadAdd.description: Added to UnitType.formationSpread when laying out pack members (looser spacing vs splash). Applied at spawn time.

convert.description: Convert-ray / ramp-beam extras (wizard Mass Binding, Prism Cannon). `maxTargets` channels at once; `intensityMult` scales each channel.

convertHealFull.description: After a successful convert, restore the victim to full HP.

freeRedeploy.description: Every deploy round this pack may be repositioned without Move Pack.

description.description: shown on hover; auto-derived from `mods` when omitted (see techDescription)

icon.description: atlas glyph; omit to show `tech-default` (question mark — missing icon)

oil.description: splash oil onto the shared hazard layer at impact (shield discs stay clear)

FireProfile.description: weapon / rocket profile — burn victims, ignite ground, and/or stamp oil

radius.description: how much ground lights up around the impact

intensity.description: DPS applied each step to ground units standing in the fire

interval.description: seconds between each completed spawn ("how often" / time to produce one)

max.description: max spawns per battle from this tech on one pack

delay.description: Seconds after the opening freeze before the first spawn. Omit = use `interval` (first unit after one production cycle).

TechProduce.description: a purchasable upgrade for a unit type — mostly multipliers; see `rangeAdd`

typeId.description: unit type id to spawn (typically a 1×1 spawn clone)

TechOnKill.description: Battle spawn on kill: each enemy this pack slays raises one `typeId` pack.
